names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 ianuarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Silvan».

Read out of saint.gr's own heading for him on the page for the three martyrs of 29 Ιανουαρίου, «Αγιος Σιλουανος ο Επισκοπος», with the rank words left off; the day's line keeps the three together as «Άγιοι Σιλουανός ο Επίσκοπος, Λουκάς ο Διάκονος και Μώκιος ο Αναγνώστης».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Pe vremea împăratului Numerian în anii 284, s-a pornit prigoană asupra creştinilor».
